channel.title: The Oakland Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: Girls basketball district finals scoreboard
item.description: All of the girls basketball district finals games, organized by division and district number, for teams covered by outlets in the MediaNews Group Michigan cluster — the Mt. Pleasant Morning Sun, the Macomb Daily, the Oakland Press, and the Southgate News Herald — on Friday, March 6, 2026.

item.title: Photos from Northville vs. No. 10 South Lyon East in a D1 girls hoops district final
item.description: South Lyon East was its own worst enemy from the free-throw line for most of the night, but things came together at the stripe in the fourth quarter for the Cougars, who came away with a 52-45 victory over Northville and a district title Friday, March 6, 2026.

item.title: South Lyon East corrects free-throw woes in fourth to beat Northville in district final
item.description: Riding a 22-1 record heading into the district finals against Northville, it might have been a forgone conclusion that South Lyon East would take charge early and easily advance to Monday's regional semifinals.

item.title: Ninth-ranked Eisenhower beats Stoney Creek 44-34 for district crown
item.description: Gabby Gojcaj would not be denied.

item.title: No. 8 OLSM handles business against Lakeland to claim first D1 district title
item.description: It probably didn’t matter which team lined up across the from the No. 8-ranked Orchard Lake St. Mary’s Eaglets in Friday’s district title game at Lakeland High School, because the Eaglets had already decided they weren’t gonna let last year happen again.

item.title: Syla Swords, Olivia Olson lead No. 8 Michigan past Oregon 80-58 in Big Ten quarterfinals
item.description: Syla Swords scored 17 points and Olivia Olson had 16 as No. 8 Michigan beat Oregon 80-58 in the Big Ten Tournament quarterfinals on Friday. night.

item.title: Photo gallery of Oxford vs. Davison in a D1 girls basketball district title game
item.description: The Oxford Wildcats lost to the Davison Cardinals 49-28 in the D1 district final played on Friday, March 6, 2026 at Oxford.

item.title: Extended drought dooms Oxford in district championship loss to Davison
item.description: The Oxford Wildcats saw their season come to an end with a 49-28 loss to the Davison Cardinals in Friday night’s district final.

item.title: Regina downs Notre Dame Prep to win sixth straight district title
item.description: Winning district crowns in nothing new for Warren Regina.

item.title: Photos of Troy vs. Troy Athens in a D1 girls hoops district championship
item.description: Troy Athens captured the program's first district championship in over two decades by beating rival Troy 50-41 Friday, March 6, 2026 at Warren Mott.
